checks.name: Clean clone: pinned versions, backend verify, frozen install, typecheck, lint, tests, web builds, Android/iOS JS bundles

scenarios.observed: check_workspace.sh from a fresh clone of the tested commit: Node 24.21.0, pnpm 10.34.6 and JDK 21 matched pins; ./mvnw verify ran enforcer (Java/Maven versions, dependency convergence) and 6 backend tests; pnpm install --frozen-lockfile succeeded; typecheck, lint, 5 web/mobile unit tests and both Vite builds passed; Expo export produced Android and iOS Hermes bundles. Native Gradle/Xcode compilation is out of scope (MB-047).

findings: Versions selected from Maven Central, npm and nodejs.org on 2026-10-11; TypeScript held at 6.0.3 because typescript-eslint supports <6.1.
React pinned to Expo SDK 57's 19.2.3 across the workspace to avoid duplicate React.
Actuator exposes only health without details; error responses never include stack traces or messages.
Defect found and repaired: guardrail tests depended on story position/status and failed after MB-001 DONE (CI run 38124549506); fixed by ID-based selection.
Residual: Windows/macOS command documentation is NOT_RUN; expo-doctor networked checks cannot run here (exp.host unresolvable); Maven Central 429 required a machine-local mirror.
